Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a Top-Down Proteomics (TDP) experiment, which is fundamentally different from bottom-up workflows. It analyzes intact proteins (proteoforms) rather than peptides. Standard bottom-up pipelines (DDA/DIA LFQ) are not applicable. Differential analysis is performed at the proteoform level, which is analogous to site-level analysis in bottom-up terms as it distinguishes specific modified/truncated versions of the same gene product.
